title: WE ARE ONE IN THE SPIRIT

lines.text: We are one in the Spirit, we are one in the Lord (2)
And we praise God our unity is now being restored.
And theyll know we are Christians,
By our love, by our love,
Yes, theyll know we are Christians
We will walk with each other, we will walk hand in hand (2)
And together well spread the news
That Christ is in our land.
We will work with each other, we will work side by side (2)
We are being built together, we are being built in love (2)
And we know that this love is coming down from above.
Now the Lord is that Spirit, and the Spirit is the Lord (2)
And He dwells in our spirit and were all in one accord.
Give all praise to the Father from whom all blessings come
And all praise to Christ Jesus the Fathers firstborn Son
And all praise to the Spirit who makes us one.
